system.description: • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional attack with your bonded weapon type as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex). Spellstrike may be delivered through either attack, still once per round.

activities.name: Extra Attack
activities.text: One additional attack with your bonded weapon type, with Disadvantage. Spellstrike may be delivered through either attack, still once per round.
